title: Mitigating GenAI-Powered Evidence Pollution for Out-Of-Context Misinformation Detection
abstract: arXiv:2501.14728v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: While generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) models have achieved significant success, their misuse for generating deceptive content raises growing concerns about online information security. Out-of-context (OOC) multimodal misinformation detection systems typically rely on Web-retrieved evidence to identify images repurposed in false contexts, but they are increasingly challenged by the presence of GenAI-polluted evidence. Existing work mainly focuses on verifying claims that have undergone stylistic rewriting at the claim level and assume a clean evidence corpus. In this work, we remove this assumption and systematically study the impact of GenAI-driven evidence pollution threat on OOC detection. We show that polluted evidence can degrade the performance of state-of-the-art detectors by more than 9 percentage points. We propose two mitigating strategies, cross-modal evidence reranking and cross-modal claim-evidence reason

translated_title: 缓解生成式AI驱动的证据污染以应对脱离上下文虚假信息检测
translated_abstract: arXiv:2501.14728v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：尽管生成式人工智能（GenAI）模型取得了显著成功，但其被滥用以生成欺骗性内容的行为引发了对在线信息安全的日益担忧。脱离上下文（OOC）的多模态虚假信息检测系统通常依赖网络检索到的证据来识别在错误语境中被重新利用的图像，但这些系统正日益受到GenAI污染证据的挑战。现有工作主要集中于验证在声明层面经过风格改写的主张，并假设证据语料库是干净的。在本研究中，我们移除了这一假设，并系统性地研究了GenAI驱动的证据污染威胁对OOC检测的影响。我们表明，污染证据可使最先进检测器的性能下降超过9个百分点。我们提出了两种缓解策略，即跨模态证据重排序和跨模态声明-证据推理。
tldr: 本研究首次系统分析了生成式AI导致的证据污染对脱离上下文虚假信息检测的威胁，发现其可使检测性能下降超9个百分点，并提出两种跨模态缓解策略以增强检测鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: This work systematically analyzes the threat of GenAI-driven evidence pollution to out-of-context misinformation detection, showing it degrades detector performance by over 9 percentage points, and proposes two cross-modal mitigation strategies to enhance robustness.
